name: Eero Mäkinen
bio:
Eero Mäkinen's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Economics from the University of Helsinki, a chance encounter with a rally team owner at a networking event sparked his interest. He started as an intern, quickly proving his aptitude for managing budgets and tracking expenses in the fast-paced world of rally racing. He moved to Toyota Gazoo Racing after a few successful seasons with a smaller team. 

Eero's approach to finance is pragmatic and data-driven. He believes in meticulous planning, rigorous cost control, and transparent reporting. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to identify potential financial risks before they escalate. What sets Eero apart is his deep understanding of the technical aspects of motorsport, allowing him to make informed financial decisions that align with the team's performance goals. He balances ambition with a grounded realism about the challenges of motorsport finance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed to the side
physical.description: Eero is of average height with a slightly stocky build.

quirks: Always carries a small abacus in his briefcase.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard for all his financial spreadsheets.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when analyzing complex financial data.
